files.label: ECL1 (event scripts)
files.note: 33 members; dax_inspect --verify closes the offset chain. decode:false because this row is data, not art -- it must render zero frames. Round 31 SUPERSEDED this note's original warning: a dispatch map was built from Matrix Cubed's own FBOV GAME.OVR (tools/map_matrix_ecl_dispatch.py) and shipped as ECL_GEN1_MATRIX, under which 30 of these 33 blocks reach a clean terminating EXIT and 3 desync (blocks 18, 20, 24) -- round 32 gave 0x29/0x2c/0x42 a measured wordSet 0, which fully resolved block 1 and moved block 18's stop later rather than clearing it. The route is ?ecl=matrix. That clean-EXIT count is a LOWER BOUND, not a health measure: it stops at each block's first EXIT, and round 33's all-entry-point walk finds 452 deep desync sites across the same 33 blocks (packages/engine/test/eclReachability.test.ts). The claim boundary still matters: the derived table came back field-for-field identical to ECL_GEN1_BUCK, so that agreement is arithmetic, not a second measurement. No Matrix Cubed leg is claimed in the campaign matrix and no gameplay route executes these blocks; single-stepping four of them in an inspector is not a playable route.

files.label: BUCKA (music, Miles AIL XMIDI)
files.note: Miles AIL XMIDI, 12,178 bytes. Round 34 R4 (docs/engine/research/matrix-cubed-audio.md) found this title's own unpacked START.EXE/GAME.OVR never open MUSIC.DAX by name and instead name BUCKA/B/C.XMI, FATV9.AD/.BNK/.CAT and five .ADV drivers -- the same Miles/AIL stack DQK ships, not the GLBR stack the other five titles in this family use. sniffXmi is true; decodeXmi (packages/engine/src/audio/xmi.ts, zero code changes) finds 7 songs, 2684 events total (per-song 897,134,244,82,213,146,968), 45 distinct-MIDI-channel count total (per-song 8,7,8,4,7,10,9). Re-measured round 34 Phase B directly through the shipped loadGame.ts xmiMusicCensus() path (not a test-local clone) and agrees exactly with round 34 R4's per-file numbers. Listing this file (with its two siblings below) is what makes loadGame.ts's hasXmiSiblings check true, which suppresses MUSIC.DAX's GLBR census below -- see that row's note.

Re-measured round 34 Phase B through the shipped loadGame.ts xmiMusicCensus() path; agrees exactly with round 34 R4's per-file numbers (docs/engine/research/matrix-cubed-audio.md).

files.label: BUCKC (music, Miles AIL XMIDI)
files.note: Miles AIL XMIDI, 2,242 bytes. sniffXmi is true; decodeXmi finds 7 songs, 395 events total (per-song 153,27,68,30,24,11,82), 7 distinct-MIDI-channel count total (per-song 0,1,1,1,1,1,1). Re-measured round 34 Phase B through the shipped loadGame.ts xmiMusicCensus() path; agrees exactly with round 34 R4's per-file numbers. Summed across BUCKA/B/C.XMI, the dashboard's aggregate music census for this title (loadGame.ts folds every musicByPath entry) reads 21 songs / 5702 events / 95 channels -- identical to round 34 R4's headline number, which R4 measured on a test-local clone of the census function rather than through this manifest; this re-measurement through the shipped manifest path confirms it rather than revising it.

files.label: FATV9.AD (Miles instrument bank)
files.note: 3,042 bytes. Decodes under the already-shipped sniffInstrAd/decodeInstrAd reader (packages/engine/src/audio/instrAd.ts, zero code changes) as an InstrAd instrument bank: 152 (patch,bank) records, the same container shape as DQK's own INSTR.AD (3,982 B, 199 instruments) -- see packages/engine/test/matrixXmi.test.ts. Not censused by loadGame.ts (no InstrAd census is wired into loadGame.ts, unlike the GLBR/XMI music census); fetched for real playback directly by apps/web/src/audio/gameAudio.ts's own hardcoded MATRIX_INSTR_AD path, independent of this manifest. Listed here for inventory completeness alongside the BUCKA/B/C.XMI rows this round added.

files.label: MUSIC (music banks, leftover)
files.note: 9 members: member 1 is the driver, members 2-9 are 8 GLBR song blocks, byte-identical to Countdown's own MUSIC.DAX (8/8 sha256) and decodable by the same already-shipped GLBR reader -- this file's bytes were never in question. Round 34 R4 (docs/engine/research/matrix-cubed-audio.md) found this title's own unpacked START.EXE/GAME.OVR never open MUSIC.DAX by name at all: they instead name BUCKA/B/C.XMI, FATV9.AD/.BNK/.CAT and five .ADV hardware drivers -- the same Miles/AIL stack DQK ships, not the GLBR stack the other five titles in this family use. This file is a leftover copy from the shared Buck Rogers Gen1 codebase, not this title's real music. loadGame.ts's hasXmiSiblings check sees the BUCKA/B/C.XMI rows above and deliberately does NOT run glbrMusicCensus on this file, so the dashboard no longer reports any GLBR song/event/channel count for it -- the '8 songs, 1959 events, 31 channel streams' this note previously published here describes Countdown's real music (the byte-identical file plays for real there), not Matrix's. Matrix's real music census is on the BUCKA/BUCKB/BUCKC.XMI rows above (21 songs / 5702 events / 95 channels summed, re-measured round 34 Phase B through the shipped census path). This row stays decode:false and is kept only as an inventory record of the leftover file.

files.label: GAME.OVR (overlay pool)
files.note: 212,529 bytes, magic FBOV (measured directly at offset 0) -- NOT TPOV. Countdown's own GAME.OVR was separately measured (commit 9b0dfeb) as TPOV, so the two Buck Rogers titles use different overlay-manager magic words; this is a genuine cross-title difference, not a typo in either measurement.

files.label: MATRIX.CFG (install config)
files.note: Five CRLF fields then a run of zeros: display mode (V), sound (S), input (N), then TWO save-path fields (C:\MATRIX\SAVE\, C:\BUCK\SAVE\) before F -- one more field than Countdown's own BUCK.CFG (V/A/M/one save path/F), otherwise the same field order and the same V in the first (display-mode) slot.
